This is great — this is exactly the feeling I was hoping for. I pasted just the web address, hit save, and it turned into something I can actually recognize: the icon, a real title, a little description, and the site name all right there. That's a huge improvement over my wall of raw links today.

And yes, all three of your choices feel right to me: one clear "Save link" button, only asking me for the address, and each saved item showing the icon, title, short description, and website name. That's just what I pictured.

Two quick things I want to confirm before we move on, since they're part of this same save-and-reopen flow:

- When I click the item itself, does it take me straight to the actual recipe page on the website? There's a little arrow icon on the row — I want to make sure tapping the bookmark gets me to the real page, since that's the whole reason I saved it.
- The title and description it pulled in look good here, but sometimes the auto-grabbed text is ugly or wrong. Will I be able to fix up the title or description myself, both right when I save and later on?

If those two hold up, I'm happy with this first flow.
